title: ClearPath Coverage and the License Change Fee Netted from Microsoft 365 Reduction Credits
content:
**Fee schedule.** The license change fee netted from a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) reduction credit depends on the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services coverage:

- **Covered work.** The client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active or notice given, and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 tenant administration as covered work. The change is covered work and the fee is **0.00 USD**.
- **ClearPath Monitor.** The client holds an active ClearPath Monitor agreement. The fee is **10.00 USD**.
- **Any other client.** The fee is not reduced under this schedule.

Whichever fee applies is netted at no more than half (50 percent) of the prorated amount of the reduction credit.

The status, the tier and the tier's Microsoft 365 administration entitlement are read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record.

| Client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement | License change fee netted |
|---|---|
| Status active, tier includes Microsoft 365 administration | 0.00 USD |
| Status notice given, tier includes Microsoft 365 administration | 0.00 USD |
| Status active, ClearPath Monitor | 10.00 USD |
| Any other status or tier, or no ClearPath agreement | no reduction under this schedule |

## Points of judgement

- An agreement under notice still counts as covered work, provided its tier includes Microsoft 365 administration.
- The 10.00 USD fee needs the ClearPath Monitor agreement to be active. A ClearPath Monitor agreement under notice is not on that line.
- The fee is netted from the reduction credit. Take a hypothetical prorated amount of 300.00 USD. Netting the fee leaves 300.00 under covered work, and 290.00 under an active ClearPath Monitor agreement.
- On a hypothetical prorated amount of 16.00 USD under an active ClearPath Monitor agreement, half of the prorated amount is 8.00. Only 8.00 of the 10.00 fee is netted, leaving 8.00.
